text: A sailor on the mole names the stars for you: a bull, a scorpion, a woman carrying water. He says the bright one at the mast’s shoulder means the grain ships will be late. He says it the way a man says the price of rope.

sources: Late Bronze Age Mediterranean celestial lore, general
provenance.notes: Star groups and sailing lore are plausible; the specific names and prediction are invented and presented as belief.
